gnda_semantics.priority_option: PowerPortNamesTakePriority changes naming precedence: off means labels before power ports; on means power ports before labels. It does not itself introduce physical or logical connectivity between different identifier types.
source_sections: Net Label Notes: different identifier types, AGND example
Net Naming Options: Power Port Names Take Priority
Two Separate Nets That Have the Same Name
gnda_semantics.exact_quote: Net identifiers of different types do not automatically connect to one another even if they share the same name.
gnda_semantics.source_branch_evidence: SIO - IT8613E has a separate 3-pin GNDA power-port branch and a 5-pin branch with both GNDA and SIO_GNDA net labels. Keep branches separate when matching schematic topology; chosen final name and duplicate-name diagnostics should be confirmed by AD native compilation.
gnda_semantics.official_conclusion: A same-name net label and power port do not automatically connect. Physical wiring or another valid connectivity path is needed.
gnda_semantics.same_type_rules: Net labels normally connect same-name labels on the same sheet; project Global scope extends labels. Same-name power ports connect project-wide unless localized by hierarchy.
gnda_semantics.limitation: Official rules plus parsed ASCII geometry support separation; no native compile has yet been run. Duplicate named separate nets can be merged when transferred to PCB, so name equality alone is insufficient as an authority for schematic equivalence.

steps: Copy the AD project plus its 35 source SchDoc documents into this isolated research folder, preserving project-relative paths.
Run the prepared DelphiScript in the installed AD18 against only that copied project.
DM_Compile, then obtain DM_DocumentFlattened and export each native net by a numeric net_index plus each associated pin.
Also export all component pins on physical documents to capture unused/no-net pins.
Compare partitions by pins and net_index; compare final names separately, because same-name source nets may still be distinct.

external_execution.command_note: The caret shown before | in the official example is cmd.exe escaping, not part of the Altium process parameter. Use a single argument in PowerShell or a proper process ArgumentList.
external_execution.process_alternative: ScriptingSystem:RunScriptFile with FileName=<pas path>|ProcName=DumpCompiledConnectivity is documented for form-free DelphiScript unit files, and the process exists locally in AD18.
external_execution.output_job_route: An independently configured copied OutJob with a Protel netlist generator can be opened as OUTPUTJOB and run through WorkspaceManager:GenerateReport, ObjectKind=OutputBatch, Action=Run. Do not hard-code a dynamically numbered Netlist Index.
external_execution.official_example_version: AD19 official Altium CI article, 2019/2020; not a guarantee of unattended AD18 behavior
external_execution.caution: This is a GUI application automation entry, not a separate headless compiler. Do not call TerminateWithExitCode or CloseObject All on an existing user session.
